description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and coverage for different models, including Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to a value slightly above 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1 starting from 0.4, but the upper limit is not explicitly labeled. The Llama-3B model is represented by a solid dark blue line, which starts at approximately 0.45 coverage at 2^0 completions and increases to around 0.8 coverage at 2^8 completions, with a steady upward trend. The Llama-3B + FT model is represented by a dashed dark blue line with triangle markers, closely following the Llama-3B line, starting at around 0.45 coverage and reaching approximately 0.8 coverage. The Llama-1B model is depicted by a solid light blue line, beginning at about 0.35 coverage and rising to nearly 0.8 coverage. The Llama-1B + FT model is shown as a dashed light blue line with triangle markers, starting at roughly 0.4 coverage and increasing to around 0.75 coverage, both Llama-1B lines exhibit a generally increasing trend across the range of completions.
